title: Ticket 1.61.10 — R41 Food Dashboard month, guests and theme reveal
notes: Keeps visible quick actions for both 7 days and the 30-day/month period (backed by the existing 30-day local API range), replaces active employees with today's guest count from local monitoring, and animates light/dark theme changes using a viewport-centred circular View Transition. Retains R40 grid isolation. No demo data, cloud dependency, migration, or unrelated module changes.
